svg.title: NVIDIA Reveals Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Bolt: What to Check First for Local Agents
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
NVIDIA Reveals Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Bolt: What to
Check First for Local Agents
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-17
Dividing the roles of the three models
Super VL is a 120B (120 billion parameters) open
model for agents that understand images, web
pages, and PDFs together.
Three things to check first when using
them locally
First, available memory. 24GB is the figure for
the model weights.
Read benchmark figures as company
claims
NVIDIA stated that Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB ranked
first among open models in the same tier on
PinchBench and second on BrowseComp.
What changes for enterprise adoption
The open weights, training data, and training
recipe are being released together, allowing
companies to perform post-training with their…
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
